description: GORG gain curve, Ar:CO2 90:10 at 15.0 psi (1.0342 bar abs., 2025-08-19); measured: V_GEM 2500-2700 V, gains 602-1930 (5 good runs). Same pulser charge scale (aug2025) as the Ar:CH4 92:8 data, so this tests whether the SimGEM/GORG gap is in the gas model or in the common charge scale. V_drift = V_GEM + 500 V.
